Since the very first Ostermoor mattress, we’ve employed the finest materials and time-tested American craftsmanship. Today’s collection is a celebration of the care and quality that have epitomized our brand all along. About Us Nearly two centuries ago, Ostermoor & Company was founded in a Manhattan neighborhood known today as Nolita. Since day one, we’ve offered our customers order-by-mail, doorstep delivery, and a satisfaction guarantee. Every Ostermoor mattress is still designed and built in America, remaining committed to the pursuit of better rest.
